solution:
**Calculation:**

Sin A = 2 / 5 , Cosec A = 5 / 2

and Sec A = 5 / √21

frac{5 sin A+2 operatorname{cosec} A}{sqrt{21} sec A}

⇒ (5 × 2/5 + 2× 5/2) / √21 × 5 / √21

⇒ (2 + 5) / 5 = 7/5
